veranderings.rede: The same sentence says 'die liggaam se brandstof'; 'liggaam' keeps the reference consistent and suits the register better than 'lyf'.
AWS 2017: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subject and verb, so a comma comes before it.

veranderings.voor: Die hout begin nie vanself brand nie en wag maande lank in die skuur.
veranderings.na: Die hout wag maande lank in die skuur en begin nie vanself brand nie.
veranderings.rede: Putting the waiting first and the 'does not start burning by itself' second reads more logically and naturally, with the same meaning.

veranderings.voor: vat vinnig vlam en die vuur
veranderings.na: vat vinnig vlam, en die vuur
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: two sentences with their own subject and verb joined by 'en' take a comma.
'uit die grond uithaal' doubles the 'uit'; 'uit die grond haal' is cleaner and keeps the protected 'uit die grond'.

veranderings.voor: diep onder die grond en ander is
veranderings.na: diep onder die grond, en ander is
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'ander is' is a second sentence with its own subject and verb, so a comma comes before 'en'.

veranderings.voor: klein bietjies petrol en die motor ry
veranderings.na: klein bietjies petrol, en die motor ry
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: two sentences with their own subject and verb joined by 'en' take a comma.

veranderings.na: vir lig en om kos gaar te maak
veranderings.rede: 'vir kos' is vague (it reads as if paraffin were food); the lesson already uses 'kos gaar maak' for cooking.

veranderings.voor: by die pit en die kers gee lig
veranderings.na: by die pit, en die kers gee lig
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: two sentences with their own subject and verb joined by 'en' take a comma.
The sentence opens with 'hierdie brandstowwe' (plural), so the singular 'die brandstof se' does not agree with what it refers to.

veranderings.voor: Baie van hulle gee vir ons ook lig
veranderings.na: Baie van hulle gee ons ook lig
veranderings.rede: 'gee ons ook lig' is smoother and matches the next sentence's 'gee ons hitte en beweging'.

veranderings.voor: Die vlam binne die enjin gee wel lig. Ons kan daardie lig nie gebruik nie.
veranderings.na: Die vlam binne die enjin gee wel lig, maar ons kan daardie lig nie gebruik nie.
veranderings.rede: 'wel' sets up a contrast that the choppy second sentence leaves hanging; joining with 'maar' makes the contrast explicit without new content.
